name: Home Chef Production Center San Bernardino CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open truck driveway off S Tippecanoe Ave at NW corner; no barrier arm across the lane at the property line, but a small check-in kiosk/call-box structure with traffic delineators sits just inside the entrance (Street View Apr 2025).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No full staffed guard booth visible. The structure at the entrance reads as a small remote check-in kiosk/call-box, not a multi-window manned shack.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled entry with a kiosk/call-box and no manned shack = remote check-in.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Company release states 30 truck docks + 1 drive-in door; dock bank runs along the NORTH building face into the shared truck court, trailers backed in confirm.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved gate apron at the Tippecanoe entrance with room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Primary truck entry/exit at the single NW driveway off Tippecanoe; a secondary SW driveway exists off the south service road (truckGateCount=2).
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs N-S in the corridor EAST of the building but does not spur INTO Home Chef's lot; it serves the property line, not the docks.
